close_reason: Made check_mx_against_policy generic over S: AsRef<str>; updated empty-slice test type annotation
description: mta_sts_mx.rs:28: fn check_mx_against_policy(mx: &str, patterns: &[String]) takes an owned String slice. Callers that have a &[&str] or &[impl AsRef<str>] must allocate String values first. &[String] is correct for callers that own the Vec<String>, but the function could be generic over impl AsRef<str> or accept &[impl AsRef<str>]. In practice this is only called from enforce_for_delivery with a Vec<String> so no allocation penalty today, but the signature is unnecessarily restrictive.
title: check_mx_against_policy takes &[String] forcing allocation at call sites
